own_solution.law: Linear and angular momentum conservation about the system centre of mass: omega = mu v d/(M L^2/12 + mu d^2)

notes: The authors' relations are equivalent to my reduced-mass form. Base 2.22222 rad/s and R 2.86349 rad/s at 0.13 kg match pass 1. I checked 0.07 kg: mu = 0.74/2.37 = 0.31224 kg, omega = 0.74937/0.28996 = 2.5844 rad/s, as claimed. Minimal pairs hold: T7EF6/T4CC0 differ only in where the clay goes (pot vs lump), and T688C/T9964 only in timing (earlier run vs before this impact), all at 0.13 kg. T6D0B and T98CE are declared numeral-free controls. The R wiring takes the stated 6 m/s as the speed of the combined lump, which is the natural reading.
